tuition.quote: For Undergraduate International Students As an international student living outside Saudi Arabia, your tuition fees are waived. You will receive a full scholarship to attend KFUPM.
tuition.notes: KFUPM 'Tuition costs and Scholarships' page for international students; no academic year printed (footer '© 2026'), a standing policy. Recorded as amount 0 because tuition is waived; the period 'year' is a convention, the page names none. The waiver comes with a full scholarship whose benefits 'may include' free on-campus housing, course texts, a monthly stipend and medical services. Conflicting official page: the Assistant Deanship of Student Excellence & Success scholarship page (https://ses.kfupm.edu.sa/scholarships, no year printed) says 'non-Saudis are expected to cover the tuition fees which is SR 20,000 per year' and offers need- and merit-based aid of 10% to 100% of tuition to international students 'inside or outside the Kingdom'. The fees-and-scholarships page is the admissions page for international applicants (the base batch8 draft's source); the reviewer decides which governs. KFUPM is not in STANDING_FEE_POLICIES: the main session decides whether it joins the standing list.
